runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The overnight cycle's run of 2026-10-23, alive when the auto runs were stopped; its process died after the Q7 commit (`7772fea4`), unfolded, and is folded here on 2026-10-26 by the interactive session at the operator's word ("Start NI"). The run file is complete (box, after-the-stop facts, self-audit and framework notes are in that commit; the audit addendum of 2026-10-23 recorded them as missing, which they were not). Price **$43.69** (2026-10-22, aggregator, flagged) x **479,560,100 shares** (one class, 10-Q cover) = cap **$20,952M**; sovereign **5.29%** (Treasury 30-year, 2026-10-22). Q1 IN; Q2 IN (regulated exception); Q3 undecided leaning against; Q4 weighs against; Q5 integrity IN, the closest call (the 2020 subsidiary guilty plea and deferred prosecution over the Merrimack Valley explosions under former officers, argued both ways), ability against; Q6 against on both parts (serial issuance alongside the dividend; pay on adjusted EPS with no capital charge). Q7 OUT on the floor: owner cash after the filer's maintenance $735.4M a year (2021 to 2025), growth 8.63% on the maintenance series; range $29.20 to $32.83 equity-only at the sovereign (the run's figure) against $43.69; no case earns ten percent. **Fair price restated at this fold from the run's own script: $11.72 equity-only (central, regulated utility)**, from the run's $12.17: one input changed, the debt credit taken on long-term debt and its current portion only ($6,234.4M raised net over the window, short-term borrowings of $503.0M and $736.0M left out), under the reading of 2026-10-23 (commit da11a073) as the utility addendum of that day applied it to the twenty armed runs; the run's own figure reproduced exactly first (`Test Runs/_research 2026-10-23 NI/fold_restate_2026-10-26.py` and its output); the growth case at the sovereign moves from $32.83 to $31.69, so the restated range is $29.20 to $31.69; all-equity -$25.93 unchanged. No box moves. Framework notes for the operator in the run file: Q5's reach over a crime under former officers; which spending the utility debt credit is set against when (e) applies; net or gross debt; a consolidated utility's minority interest; `tools/run.py` printed total capitalization under its debt heading for this filer. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; five commits, own paths only. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the restated equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor: a six-state gas utility with an Indiana electric arm building generation for data centers, priced at $43.69 against a range of $29.20 to $31.69 equity-only; fair $11.72 (restated at the fold under the long-term-debt reading). Q5 the closest call: the 2020 guilty plea over the Merrimack Valley explosions, under officers since gone. Folded three days late after its overnight cycle died.
